candidates.reason: Primary verification surface: this is the only test module that asserts Selector.type for every flavor (html/xml/json/text) and exercises nested selector construction directly. TestSelector.test_flavor_detection* pin the response-to-type mapping changed in scrapy/selector/unified.py, and TestJMESPath covers nested jmespath/css/xpath chaining on JSON payloads, which is exactly the path that loses the parsel-derived type when Selector forces type='html' for selectors constructed without a response (root=...).

Secondary verification surface: these tests assert response.selector.type and selector shortcut/chaining behavior for TextResponse subclasses (including JsonResponse handling), so they exercise the same Selector.__init__ type-resolution branch from the response side and would catch regressions in how Scrapy maps responses to parsel types.
